title: Engineering All-Hands Notes - 2026-07-01
body:
Attendees: All engineering teams (serving runtime, platform, infra, observability, SRE, private deployments, applied ML, devex, product reps)

Summary (TL;DR):
- Stable week overall; one customer-facing degradation on 2026-06-29 related to KV cache invalidation during a model rollout. Full mitigation applied and follow-up postmortem scheduled.
- P50 token latency improved ~6% after kernel selection tweak on staging; rolling to prod next week for low-traffic regions.
- Dedicated capacity onboarding pilot with AcmeHealth completed smoke tests; next step: load validation next sprint.
- Console release (v1.12) shipped behind feature flag: improved per-route cost breakdown and rollout controls.

Metrics snapshot (week ending 2026-06-30):
- Hosted API aggregate qps: 38k (+3% WoW)
- Median token latency (hosted): 130ms (-6% WoW)
- 99th percentile latency (eu-west): 1.8s (stable)
- Error rate (token generation errors): 0.23% (spike to 0.9% during 2026-06-29 incident)
- Dedicated utilization: 62% across reserved pools
- Autoscale bugs reported: 2 (both infra edge cases)

Incidents & Postmortem items:
- Incident: KV cache invalidation during model rollout (2026-06-29 11:14-11:42 UTC)
  - Impact: Customers on a particular routing policy saw elevated token error rates and small rate of request timeouts.
  - Root cause: Race between KV cache flush and new model shard warming that caused stale-only lookups, resulting in repeated cache misses and downstream resource pressure.
  - Rollback/Mitigation: Rolled back rollout and applied short-term patch to ensure synchronous warming for affected shard set; throttled rollout for next 24h.
  - Action: Postmortem doc in Confluence (linked); engineering owner: Maya Chen; SRE lead: Diego Rivera.

Roadmap & Projects updates:
- Serving runtime:
  - Kernel selector tuning landed on staging (PR #891). Observed p50 improvements on long-context workloads. Production rollout planned 2026-07-06 low-traffic window.
  - KV cache instrumentation: additional metrics added to tracing. Next: add per-customer cache hit histograms.
- Platform engineering / Routing:
  - Smart routing policy alpha ready for internal dogfood; supports region + cost tier routing. Work to add model-variant fallback scheduled next sprint.
  - Dedicated capacity: completed initial networking hardening for customer VPC peering. Load validation with AcmeHealth in next sprint.
- Private deployments:
  - Packaging improvements: simplified Helm charts and offline installer for on-prem customers. Internal testing passed; documentation draft up on Confluence.
- Console & Observability:
  - v1.12 feature-flag rollout: per-route cost diffs and token-level tracing. A/B test telemetry enabled for 10% of users.
  - Alert fatigue work: reduced noisy alerts by tuning thresholds for cache-thrashing incidents.
- Optimize (cost/perf toolkit):
  - Batching recommendation engine prototype shows 12-18% cost regression reduction in synthetic tests. Need more production traces to validate.

Hiring & org notes:
- Headcount: hiring for two senior infra engineers and one product manager for Optimize. Interviews ongoing.
- Reminder: Eng offsite planning doc (Aug 12-13) up for RSVP. Please mark dietary restrictions in the sheet.

Shoutouts:
- Shoutout to Maya and Diego for quick mitigation on the KV incident and for getting the hotfix out under pressure.
- Thanks to the runtime team (Priya, Alex) for landing kernel selector changes and coordinating the staging roll.

Risks / blockers:
- Model rollout safety: current warming logic has edge cases for multi-shard models; must be hardened before aggressive canary policies.
- Autoscaler edgecases affecting Dedicated during burst traffic - infra team to pair with Dedicated for next 2 weeks.
- Observability retention costs rising; finance/product to align on retention tier pricing before expanding logs retention.

Action items (owner - due):
1) Postmortem writeup and retro session (Maya Chen, Diego Rivera) - due 2026-07-03
2) Production rollout plan for kernel selector (Priya Desai) - due 2026-07-05
3) Add per-customer cache-hit histograms to tracing (Alexandra Park) - due 2026-07-10
4) Load validation test plan with AcmeHealth (Platform Eng lead) - due 2026-07-09 (owner: Diego Rivera)
5) Update console docs for v1.12 features and link examples (Docs + DevEx) - due 2026-07-06
6) Hiring: finalize candidate slate for senior infra roles (Hiring manager: Samir Patel) - due 2026-07-14

Next all-hands: 2026-07-08 10:00 PT (notes will be posted in the same drive).

Appendix / Useful links: Confluence page for this all-hands, incident postmortem, PR #891, Dedicated onboarding checklist (links above).

Meeting notes captured by: Samir Patel
